purpose: Fixed exploratory comparison of classifier support windows; no production-default change.

unchanged_policy.category_aggregation: Maximum mapped category score across all 527 model labels.
unchanged_policy.postprocessing: Existing product threshold/merge/chunk behavior, with maximum emitted support length 5 seconds for both arms.

selection: Fixed dev_1 EBR0 NEC2/POLY0 and NEC4/POLY1; lexicographically first official evaluation WAV matching each same condition. No outcome substitutions.

dataset.name: DCASE 2016 Task 2 synthetic office-sound mixtures
dataset.attribution: DCASE 2016 Task 2; test-package credits Grégoire Lafay, IRCCYN, Ecole Centrale de Nantes, France.
dataset.split_independence: The official task describes the evaluation source pool as independent of training/development. This is protocol-level source-pool separation; independence between the two selected heldout mixtures is not established, and model pretraining overlap is unknown.
dataset.calibration_exposure: Both calibration mixtures belong to development material overlapping sources exposed in the earlier pilot; the two calibration mixtures also share sources.
dataset.filename_ebr: All four filenames have literal EBR token 0; inconsistent upstream dB-range prose is not reinterpreted.
dataset.license_discrepancy: The official-linked evaluation provider declares CC BY 4.0; the DCASE datalist says CC BY 3.0. The test-package README supplies task attribution but no resolving license statement.
dataset.use: Research-only evaluation. No audio is redistributed; original dataset licenses and attribution requirements remain applicable.

preprocessing.input: Complete 120-second mono 44100 Hz, 16-bit PCM files, from original time zero.
preprocessing.output: Mono 16000 Hz little-endian float32; 80000 samples per baseline window, 32000 per experimental window.
preprocessing.timeline: No seek, trim, time shift or tempo change; identical full-file conversion for both arms.
preprocessing.boundary: Existing window_starts until recording covered, real support end; silence peak <=1e-5 before padding; only final partial crop padded to its own arm length. No planned 120s input requires padding.

metrics.segment: Half-open 1s bins; any positive overlap; pooled TP/FP/FN/TN and P/R/F1.
metrics.covered_reference: One count per annotated knock or doorslam with strictly positive overlap against union predicted broad-door support.
metrics.false_positive_support_seconds: Measure(predicted door union minus annotated door union).
metrics.drawer_confuser_false_positive_seconds: Measure((predicted door union intersect annotated drawer union) minus annotated door union); exclude true-door/polyphonic overlap.
metrics.reference_taxonomy: Annotated knock plus doorslam only. These physical-door references are narrower than the product broad-door category, which also includes cupboard opening/closing. Specific drawer-associated errors must be interpreted from the observed source labels, not assumed to be cupboard classifications.
metrics.negative_truth: Complete knock/doorslam annotations define physical-door-negative time only. Such time may contain other sounds or valid broad product-category sounds.
metrics.precision: TP / (TP + FP); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.recall: TP / (TP + FN); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.f1: 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN); null if denominator is zero.
metrics.pooling: Sum confusion counts across files, then calculate rates; do not average per-file rates.
metrics.covered_reference_caveat: Any positive overlap counts a reference once; this is not a one-to-one event match, IoU threshold, event-count accuracy, or precise onset/offset measure.

execution_plan.order: Digital-zero controls; both arms on each calibration file; freeze gate result; heldout only if gate passes. Baseline then candidate for every file.
execution_plan.calibration_gate: Strictly higher pooled half-open 1s-segment broad-door F1 AND no fewer covered physical door references. Failure is NOT_ADVANCED with no heldout inference, no tuning, no retry.
execution_plan.unsupported_input_policy: Stop on incompatibility; no fallback to five-second padding or outcome-dependent substitutions.

two_second_support.qualification: Variable-frame mechanics accepted the inputs. No documented supported 2-second minimum or 2-second quality guarantee was established.
two_second_support.localization: Clip-level classifier supports do not establish precise physical event onset or offset.

source_identity.metric_formulas: Unchanged half-open one-second segment definitions and rate formulas from the preceding environmental-event pilot.
source_identity.hash_scope: Hashes identify observed bytes, not provider-signed provenance or absence of model-training overlap.
